cards.russian: Я встаю в шесть часов почти каждый день.
cards.transliteration: Ya vstayu v shest' chasov pochti kazhdyy den'.
cards.english: I get up at six o'clock almost every day.

cards.russian: Тогда я обычно вставала в пять утра.
cards.transliteration: Togda ya obychno vstavala v pyat' utra.
cards.english: Back then I usually got up at five in the morning.
It is seven o'clock now in London.

cards.russian: Самолёт вылетает в восемь часов утра.
cards.transliteration: Samolyot vyletaet v vosem' chasov utra.
cards.english: The plane departs at eight in the morning.

cards.russian: Мы начнём завтра в девять часов.
cards.transliteration: My nachnyom zavtra v devyat' chasov.
cards.english: We will start tomorrow at nine o'clock.
There are four people in my family.

cards.russian: Билл старше меня на два года.
cards.transliteration: Bill starshe menya na dva goda.
cards.english: Bill is two years older than me.

cards.russian: Он старше меня на три года.
cards.transliteration: On starshe menya na tri goda.
cards.english: He is three years older than me.

cards.russian: Её часы отстают на десять минут.
cards.transliteration: Eyo chasy otstayut na desyat' minut.
cards.english: Her watch is ten minutes slow.
